application_steps.value: Short proposal first (form, pitch deck and video); full proposal requires a GO decision, followed by assessment/interview and financing-specific steps.

deadline_scope.value: 2026 full proposal (Step 2), requiring GO on the short proposal; short proposals are submitted separately on a rolling basis.

founder_scenario.value: Natural persons willing to establish an SME are listed. A Berlin AI software idea alone proves neither TRL 6–8 innovation nor full eligibility. Short proposal comes first; a GO is needed for the full proposal. Overall eligibility remains UNKNOWN.

funding.value: Grant component below EUR 2.5 million for TRL 6–8 innovation activities; investment component EUR 1–10 million is a separate financing component.

geography.value: Applicants from EU Member States and Horizon Europe associated countries, subject to applicant-type and scheme conditions; third-country relocation rules apply.

obligations.value: Blended finance may include direct equity or quasi-equity such as convertible loans; grant-only and investment-only pathways differ.

short_proposal_status.value: Short proposals may be submitted at any time, with monthly batching. This is distinct from the full-proposal cutoff and is not a verified complete applicant eligibility decision.

source_review.value: Official page accessible; every previously cited page quotation was still present at 2026-10-23T09:48:17.679157+00:00. Full-page hash changed. Full eligibility and possible uncited term changes still require review.

unincorporated.value: Natural persons willing to establish an SME are listed; third-country relocation must precede the full application where applicable. Full eligibility is not established.

deadline_scope: 2026 full proposal (Step 2), requiring GO on the short proposal; short proposals are submitted separately on a rolling basis.

resources.quotation: If your short proposal receives a GO, you can submit your full proposal to any of the 2026 batching dates. Prepare your full proposal on Funding and Tenders portal. The full proposal consists of a 20 page form expanding on the short proposal template , pitch deck in PDF, implementation plan, financial information, Letters of Intent, FTO analysis & a 3 minutes video pitch.
